title: MEMO_ID at u64 max, mapped to to_muxed_id
pattern: MEMO_ID 2^64-1 (above int64): JSON as a string, and CAP-0067 copies it into the transfer event as to_muxed_id (u64).

hazards.placement: MEMO_ID carried into the transfer event as to_muxed_id (u64)
u64 above int64 max in JSON

facts.says: The transfer event carries it as to_muxed_id u64.
